title: Kashmir, Ladakh, or Jammu?
description: Three regions. Three different starting points.

copy.original: Three regions. Three different starting points.
copy.value: Three regions. Three different starting points.

copy.original: Kashmir offers lake life and valley stays. Ladakh calls for deliberate planning around altitude, driving, and permissions. Jammu offers hill-country stays and a Katra base option.
copy.value: Kashmir offers lake life and valley stays. Ladakh calls for deliberate planning around altitude, driving, and permissions. Jammu offers hill-country stays and a Katra base option.

copy.original: Compare the journey, not just the number
copy.value: Compare the journey, not just the number

copy.original: Look at nights, sharing, transport, meals, and optional costs. A lower headline price does not automatically mean the same services. Ask for an itemised proposal.
copy.value: Look at nights, sharing, transport, meals, and optional costs. A lower headline price does not automatically mean the same services. Ask for an itemised proposal.
